gui.modrecipebook.debug.title: Debug
gui.modrecipebook.debug.discover.tip: Fills the book with every recipe in the pack at once, so nothing is left to discover.
gui.modrecipebook.debug.reset.tip: Empties the book completely: every recipe and every item you have ever held is forgotten, as if the world were brand new.
gui.modrecipebook.debug.rethink.tip: Rebuilds the book from the items you have found: recipes you should not have yet are hidden, and the ones you have earned are opened.
gui.modrecipebook.debug.disabled: Available only while you are in a world
